GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence is used to say your name? (1 mark)
   A. Auf Wiedersehen.
   B. Wie heißt du?
   C. Wie geht's?
   D. Ich heiße Anna.

2. Which goodbye is friendly and used between friends? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Tschüss
   C. Guten Tag
   D. Gute Nacht

3. What does "Tschüss" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bye (friendly)
   B. yes
   C. good day (daytime greeting)
   D. please

4. What is the gist of the text "Guten Morgen! Ich heiße Neema. Ich bin neun. Auf Wiedersehen!"? (1 mark)
   A. A family goes to bed
   B. Two friends talk about the weather
   C. A boy asks for food
   D. A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye

5. What does "die Oma" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandmother
   B. son
   C. grandfather
   D. parents

6. What does "der Freund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. grandfather
   D. friend

7. What does "der Löffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. house
   C. spoon
   D. window

8. What does "im" stand for? (1 mark)
   A. in die
   B. an dem
   C. in der
   D. in dem

9. Which day comes right after Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Montag
   D. Samstag

10. What does "heute" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. always
   B. now
   C. often
   D. today

11. What number is "sechs"? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 18
   D. 2

12. What number is "sechzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 20

13. What does "das Frühstück" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. breakfast
   C. cabbage or kale
   D. sugar

14. In "Fischers Fritz fischt frische Fische", which sound repeats? (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. z
   C. f
   D. k

15. What does "Was ist das?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is that?
   B. How is that?
   C. Where is that?
   D. Who is that?

16. Which body word contains the letter ß? (1 mark)
   A. Fuß
   B. Hand
   C. Bein
   D. Kopf

17. What does "das Gewitter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. sky
   C. rain
   D. rainbow

18. What does "Wie ist das Wetter?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. What time is it?
   C. Where is the house?
   D. Who is there?

19. Which phrase is correct for "in the kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. im Küche
   B. in die Küche
   C. in dem Küche
   D. in der Küche

20. Which room do you link with "Ich dusche"? (1 mark)
   A. das Badezimmer
   B. das Wohnzimmer
   C. der Garten
   D. die Küche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)

22. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

23. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)

24. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

25. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

26. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

27. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

28. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

29. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)

30. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Ich heiße Anna.
   Ich heiße ... means My name is ...

2. B — Tschüss
   Tschüss is the relaxed way of saying bye.

3. A — bye (friendly)
   Tschüss means bye (friendly).

4. D — A girl greets, gives her name and age, and says goodbye
   The words Guten Morgen, ich heiße, ich bin neun and Auf Wiedersehen show a greeting, a name, an age and a goodbye.

5. A — grandmother
   die Oma means grandmother.

6. D — friend
   der Freund means friend.

7. C — spoon
   der Löffel means spoon.

8. D — in dem
   im is the short form of in dem.

9. B — Mittwoch
   After Dienstag comes Mittwoch.

10. D — today
   heute means today.

11. A — 6
   sechs is the number 6.

12. A — 16
   sechzehn is the number 16.

13. B — breakfast
   das Frühstück means breakfast.

14. C — f
   Every word begins with f or sch or f.

15. A — What is that?
   was means what.

16. A — Fuß
   Fuß has ß.

17. A — thunderstorm
   das Gewitter means thunderstorm.

18. A — What is the weather like?
   das Wetter is the weather.

19. D — in der Küche
   Küche is a die word.

20. A — das Badezimmer
   A shower is in the bathroom.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.
